notes: Access: direct HTTP fetch (curl), no blocking, robots.txt allows crawling (Shopify storefront). Discovery: (1) parsed homepage mega-menu HTML for dedicated Bestsellers tiles per product-category dropdown (Lighting, Outdoor, Mirrors & Art, Rugs), (2) fetched full site collections.json (726 collections, paginated) and keyword-scanned titles/handles for best/top/popular/trending/favorite, (3) checked homepage 'Explore Our Best Sellers' carousel section. No dedicated Furniture-only or Decor-only Bestsellers PLP exists (Furniture and Pillows&Decor mega-menus have no such tile; collections.json has no furniture-best/decor-best handle). QTY METHOD: Shopify collections.json 'products_count' is proven inflated on this site (established in prior Home-Decor pass and reconfirmed here); used the rendered utility-bar 'N products' header instead, and cross-verified 4 of 5 rows exactly against a full products.json pagination exhaustion (best-sellers-items: header=7, products.json=7; mirrors-art-best: header=31, products.json=31; matches also reconfirmed for two New Arrivals rows). REJECTED CANDIDATE: Rugs mega-menu has a tile literally labelled 'Rug Bestsellers' but its href is /collections/rugs -- the plain, full Rugs category page (thousands of products), not a curated bestseller subset. This fails the 'genuinely represents a bestseller/popularity merchandising concept' test (it is the whole catalog under a bestseller-sounding label), so it was excluded rather than recorded as a row. /collections/best-sellers (114 products) is a real, fully-formed Shopify collection (own og:title 'Best Sellers') discoverable via collections.json/sitemap but not currently linked from primary nav or homepage; included as a genuine PLP per the discovery rules (sitemap/collections listing is a valid discovery channel, not just live nav).
